intro: An app is a name and a key, so Usage can show which app used which recipes, how long and at what energy. It is a label for counting, not an account: a key admits exactly what the shared token does. Calls without a valid key are counted as anonymous.

list.name: Name
list.empty: No apps yet. Create one to count its calls apart.
list.hint: Revoke stops the key and keeps the name taken. Delete frees the name: the app's history stays in Usage, and a new app under the same name adds to it.

key.once: Copy the key now: it is shown only once. giq keeps only its hash, so it cannot be shown again.
key.howTo: The app sends it where an API key goes: api_key in the OpenAI SDKs, which they send as Authorization: Bearer. X-Giq-Token or ?token= work too.

revoke.confirmBody: Its key stops working at once. Its history stays, and the name stays taken, so the app cannot be created again under it.

delete.confirmBody: The entry and its key are removed. Its history stays in Usage under the name, and a new app created under the same name adds to that history.
